sources.author: kveld9
patch_list: Stops sites from reading motion sensors to identify you.
Blocks rating popups, review requests and promo dialogs.
Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.
Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, and VPN.
Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.
Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.
Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.
Replaces the new tab page background with a custom wallpaper chosen at patch time. For best results, select an image matching your device screen resolution.
Stops Brave from minimizing your tabs in the background.
Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.
Skips welcome, search choice and onboarding on fresh installs.
Stops background wakeups and battery drain.
Stops tips, reward promos and marketing notifications.
Stops sending page text to the Android capture service.

sources.label: Unlock your digital freedom. Free yourself from Big tech Corporations
sources.author: Proteus
patch_list: Attempts to disable Chromium's Android sensor provider; may also block ambient sensors. Requires device validation.
Disables the identified rating and Brave Ads signup eligibility checks; other dialogs can still appear.
Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.
Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, and VPN.
Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.
Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.
Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.
Disables the identified new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity. Does not prevent tab unloading under memory pressure.
Replaces larger unselected Chromium locale PAKs with the English fallback; gender variants and Android resources are not removed.
Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.
Reports the first-run flow complete; may skip essential consent, search or setup screens.
Disables the identified Chromium background-sync scheduler gate; other wakeups remain and site background sync can break.
Disables identified Chromium tips and retention notification entry points; other notifications may remain.
Disables Chromium's OnscreenContentProvider content-capture gate, not every possible text-sharing mechanism.
